Welcome back to the show. Today we are talking about growing a small business.
And so we started with almost nothing in the bank.

Here is the most important lesson about pricing. Never compete on price alone.
Customers pay for value, not for the cheapest option. That changed everything for us.

So, what happened next was pretty boring, to be honest.
We moved offices and bought some new chairs.

Let me tell you the biggest mistake we made with pricing.
We doubled our prices overnight, and half our customers left in one week!
It was a disaster, but we learned exactly what our customers valued.

Thanks for listening, and see you next time.
